intro.text: A kind of spren able to form a Nahel bond, which makes a person a Truthwatcher.

description.text: In the Cognitive Realm mistspren are usually humanlike, though unlike most sapient spren they can take other shapes. Their voices chime, and their clothes are not part of them.
Many work as ordinary crew on honorspren ships, doing most of the work aboard without seeming to mind.

items.text: They can hide inside their Radiant, dim their sight and leave a red afterimage around them in Shadesmar.
In Shadesmar, they resemble red mist around a ruby, with a shifting empty space in place of a face.
They share thoughts and emotions with their Radiants and help them understand rhythms.
